verdicts.reason: A: SOLSTICE sits below the headline, which breaks the reading order. The 'Find It Near You' CTA is shrunk to the size of the badges, and the CTA and two pills wrap into a ragged cluster with SUMMER ONLY on its own line. The headline sits on the green circle, which has come loose from the phone, and the phone is pushed far right with dead space between them. B: SOLSTICE now comes before the headline, and the big headline keeps a clear hierarchy. But the phone almost touches the end of 'back', the CTA is again a tiny pill the size of the badges, SUMMER ONLY is orphaned far below the other pills, and the circle has moved behind the text instead of framing the phone. B is less bad because its brand-then-headline order and hierarchy hold up better.
